A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same MoPFormer study. Their main text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–E are readable and reliably matchable. v2 removes the checklist but retains the research appendices.

before.justification: v1 reports original six-dataset classification results, component and hyperparameter ablations, and empirical motion-primitive analyses in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains those original results and adds repeated-seed fine-tuning results in Appendix B.5 and Table 7.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.3 retain the same segmentation, vector quantization, statistical and metadata embeddings, Transformer, task heads, and training objectives. Acronym expansions and wording edits do not change the method.

E1.justification: Both versions use PAMAP2, DSADS, MHealth, RealWorld, UCI-HAR, and USC-HAD for the same HAR tasks. The new seed analysis revisits three existing datasets without adding a population, task, or input scenario.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains the same six comparators: BYOL with perm_jit, lfc, or Mixup, plus ModCL, TSLANet, and CALANet. Table 7 adds repeated MoPFormer measurements without revising an existing comparator set.

E3.justification: The 100 Hz resampling, non-overlapping 500-sample windows, 20/80 fine-tuning/test split, and accuracy/macro-F1 metrics remain unchanged. B.5 states that it repeats the existing fine-tuning protocol. Conflicting descriptions of head-only versus Transformer fine-tuning already appear in v1; no protocol revision is established.

E4.justification: Appendix B.5 adds a focused analysis of fine-tuning sensitivity to random seeds on PAMAP2, DSADS, and RealWorld. Existing component ablations, hyperparameter sweeps, and motion-primitive similarity, frequency, and transition analyses are retained.

E5.justification: v1 explicitly acknowledges the absence of performance uncertainty reporting. v2 introduces means and standard deviations from three additional fine-tuning runs with different seeds on three of six benchmarks. This substantially changes statistical reporting, although it covers neither repeated pretraining nor baseline uncertainty.

E6.justification: Tables 1–6 and existing figure results are unchanged. New Table 7 reports accuracy/F1 means of 87.49/85.74 for PAMAP2, 97.27/97.11 for DSADS, and 91.32/92.65 for RealWorld, each with standard deviations. These supplement the retained original scores rather than establish gains from a revised method.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and objectives in Equations 1–13 are unchanged. Neither version supplies theoretical propositions or proofs, and v2 adds none.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the claims of strong HAR performance, unified learning across heterogeneous datasets, and interpretable motion primitives. Removing 'in our experiments' from one contribution bullet does not materially alter the claims already made elsewhere.

C2.justification: The explanations of motion primitives and Appendix E's computational-overhead limitation remain unchanged. Removing checklist item 10 drops the brief application-level argument that accurate real-time HAR can reduce false-prediction harms in healthcare, fitness tracking, and surveillance.

D1.justification: Architecture settings, optimization details, hardware, preprocessing, and the Google text-embedding-004 disclosure are retained. Checklist removal deletes the promised code release, proposed usage guidelines, and CC BY 4.0 license statement; this establishes a loss of documentation, not withdrawal of an available resource.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion and reference list are unchanged. No cited works or substantive positioning relative to previous research are added or removed.

P1.justification: v2 makes localized language, acronym, and appendix-heading edits; updates affiliations, contact details, and conference information; adds acknowledgments and B.5; and removes the checklist. The main narrative and section order remain intact.

P2.justification: v2 adds Table 7 and reflows the unchanged appendix figures, including placing Figure 12 on its own page. Existing plots and table structures are retained, with limited caption and front-matter formatting changes.

improvement.justification: Appendix B.5 partially addresses v1's acknowledged lack of uncertainty reporting and reveals substantial PAMAP2 variability. The benefit is limited to three datasets and fine-tuning seeds; baseline uncertainty and inconsistent fine-tuning descriptions remain unresolved. Despite losing code-release and license disclosures with the checklist, the added empirical transparency provides a modest net improvement.
